changes: Accept one exact complete lowercase json fence as a transport wrapper.
Require an explicit public stage schema; do not coerce or complete values.

envelope_contract.code_inside_json_strings: Data only; never executed, interpreted or extracted.
envelope_contract.outer_whitespace: ASCII space, tab, CR and LF only
envelope_contract.unicode: UTF-8 scalar values; reject unpaired surrogate escapes

prospective_execution_rules: Publish and bind adapter, protocol, tests, new runner, model, prompts, tasks and tools before any candidate inference.
Use new exclusive output directories and fresh offline worker processes; preserve both earlier frozen runs and their original scores.
Use unchanged Qwen prompts, worker decoding and parameters; no model selection or outcome-dependent retries.
Pass only the existing public task fields to the model; never use expected answers, oracle payloads or scripted-controller output.
After decode, keep original legal_payload and tool dispatch checks; retain SQL authorizer, query-only mode, output and progress limits.
Charge decoding time to the episode host envelope; enforce unchanged request, tool, episode and global admission deadlines.
Record original response bytes and hash, schema, envelope mode or rejection code, body hash, and unmodified decoded value.
Retain every admitted intent, terminal, tool and verifier event, including parse failures, timeouts and aborted qualification.
Keep actual unknown currency costs null; do not double-count intent/terminal or nested host/worker/generation time.
qualification_rule: One separate fixed [1] request. If transport, identity, or exact schema qualification fails, record an aborted candidate run and all 16 task episodes as not started; no retry or prompt change.
reporting: Report qualification separately from the 16 planned task episodes.
Separate native JSON, fenced JSON, parser acceptance, legal payload, actual tool dispatch, delivered answer and exact-verifier correctness.
Any gain is a disclosed development integration observation; no independent confirmation, NDU advantage or net-benefit claim.
If this fixed adapter fails, preserve that failure. Do not widen acceptance rules within the candidate run.

schemas.qualification: Exactly one integer 1 in an array; true, 1.0 and strings do not qualify.
schemas.rows_answer: Array of at most 50 row arrays, each at most 32 scalar JSON cells; no nested containers in cells.
schemas.source_read: Exactly needle:string length 1..128, or start_line:integer>=1 and line_count:integer 1..120; bool is not integer.
schemas.sql_query: Object with exactly query:string, length 1..4000 characters; original SQL worker authorization remains mandatory.
schemas.strings_answer: Array of strings; no expected answer length or contents are encoded.

selection_context.observed_pattern: Parent reported that the fixed Qwen qualification and multiple task outputs use JSON fences.

task_design.order: Task file order; alternate arm order by task index parity
